description: Exactly the manuscript logic: soil temperature and soil water as declared in site_info.csv, detected growing season, each column's own bounds definition. Must reproduce the frozen oracle.
Measured soil temperature wherever the quality screen passes it; the TS ~ TA regression only where it fails. Isolates the effect of no longer discarding good sensors (finding F10).
As screened, but a failed sensor is reconstructed by the blocked-CV-selected memory model (finding F12) instead of TS ~ TA.
As memfill, with one bounds definition -- half-hourly percentiles -- for every column, removing the inconsistency in finding F4.
As original, but the 14-day windows tile the whole year. Season detection still sets the year gap scan and the control year; see the documented future work for a fully season-free variant.

As original, but the windows tile the detector's own season with the gStart/gEnd overrides in site_info.csv ignored. Measures how much of the season definition is hand-set at the 24 sites that declare one.

As memfill_hh, but step 01 qualifies years and screens on the raw declared sensor instead of the manuscript's repaired or reconstructed column. The 27 sites whose TS_measured is partly or wholly derived get a real truth to fill against; a site whose sensor is too sparse to qualify a year fails its own target and drops from this recipe.
